text_block_list.text:
At long last, we've arrived at the
legendary ramen
shop!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We're going to create the best ramen
shop in
Japan, and to do that... we've
gotta steal their
flavors!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So yeah, we're ordering everything on
the menu!
Follow my lead, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon! Don't chicken out now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Wait a second... Maybe focusing all our energies only on the house special is our best shot...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Of course! The house special is the very

manifestation of the ramen chef's heart
and soul!
Why bother with the rest?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
All right, Chef! What's your top
recommendation
here?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Aww, yeah! Let's start from the top!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But our struggle wasn't for nothing. I can
see our
path to victory!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Take my hand! We'll conquer every
challenge on
the long, rugged road to
ramen mastery!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп smiles defiantly as the crimson
sun
glimmers at her back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп savors her bowl of legendary
golden
broth and thin, springy noodles.
She's taken a
major first step on the path
to ramen mastery.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
